Devon (Support): Thistledale (tenant=thistledale-prod-42) reporting p99 embed latency ~7.2s and intermittent 504s since ~09:15 UTC. p95 sitting ~820ms. Customer says it started after their nightly batch, but they also saw a small platform deploy earlier. Raising to SRE to triage. sample req id: req-8f3a2c (sent to support@).

Jamie (SRE): Thanks — can you paste a couple of sample request bodies and the curl they used? Also which region are they in?

Devon (Support): They repro with this curl (EU-WEST-1):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small-v2","input":["doc1","doc2"],"tenant":"thistledale-prod-42"}'
```

Devon (Support): Customer says average token size small (~32 tokens) but they do bulk batches every 5m (~1200 inputs). They see timeouts from SDK then spike.

ops-bot: ALERT: embeddings-p99 > 5s (eu-west-1) for tenant thistledale-prod-42 — triggered at 2026-02-11T09:17:42Z.

Ravi (Infra): Looking at infra metrics now. There's a simultaneous surge from tenant oakgrove-bulk (tenant=oakgrove-eng-11) pushing large embed jobs (~30k tiny requests) around 09:12-09:20. Queue depth on shard s-eu-03 jumped to 420 -> CPU steal also spiked on hosts servicing that shard. Interleaving appears to be causing KV cache churn.

Jamie (SRE): That matches. Thistledale is hitting p99 as requests are getting de-prioritized by the per-tenant fairness queue. Two quick mitigations: (1) add thistledale to priority lane / allowlist so they bypass interleaving for 30m; (2) reserve a small ephemeral capacity for them (reservation id) to stop contention. Which do we prefer as a temporary fix?

Sara (Customer Success): Customer is on a paid plan and agrees to a short reserved slot while we investigate. They asked us to avoid rolling back infra deploy unless necessary.

Devon (Support): Confirming — they want the temporary reservation. Requesting SRE/infra to create ephemeral reservation and add allowlist bypass.

Ravi (Infra): Okay I'll create a 1-hour reservation on shard pool eu-embed-small-2 and add thistledale-prod-42 to the interleaving allowlist. Reservation created: RES-2026-77 (1 vGPU-equivalent until 10:30 UTC). Changes pushed to routing: allowlist entry added.

ops-bot: CONFIG: applied allowlist entry for tenant thistledale-prod-42 (scope: interleaving-bypass) by Ravi at 2026-02-11T09:21:05Z.

Jamie (SRE): After the change p99 down to ~680ms, p95 ~420ms for thistledale on eu-west-1. Queue depth for s-eu-03 dropped from 420 -> 120 over 3 minutes. Looks like mitigation working. We'll keep reservation until 10:30 UTC and monitor.

Devon (Support): Shared update to customer, they're seeing much better latency and no more SDK timeouts. They asked: will this recur? What's permanent fix?

Jamie (SRE): Short answer: yes it can recur while oakgrove-bulk continues high-volume bursts. Long term options: (a) recommend oakgrove use bulk-embeds reservation or rate-limited submission (they probably should be on dedicated capacity), (b) increase autoscale/weighted-sharding for the eu pool, or (c) allowlist critical tenants / provide dedicated capacity for Thistledale. We'll open a follow-up to product (suggest default bulk-job detection + auto-reserve hints).

Ravi (Infra): I'll open infra ticket INF-2026-211 to investigate shard weighting and hot-tenants detection. Early note: we saw excessive KV cache eviction on s-eu-03 tied to oakgrove's high QPS with many small contexts. Possible improvements: prefer co-locating oakgrove on different pool or force-batch small requests to reduce scheduling overhead.

Sara (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with Thistledale to schedule a next-step convo (upgrade path: Dedicated or Reserved). Devon, please attach logs + the sample req-ids and the RES-2026-77 info to the CS ticket.

Devon (Support): Done — ticket CS-3291 updated with sample req ids (req-8f3a2c, req-8f3a9f) and the reservation id. Also left notes: mitigation applied, customer confirmed improvement.

Jamie (SRE): Action items: 1) Ravi INF-2026-211 to investigate root cause and propose longer-term cluster config (owner: Ravi). 2) Jamie to add a short runbook for on-call to create ephemeral reservation + allowlist and when to escalate to product (owner: Jamie). 3) Devon/Sara to follow up with Thistledale about upgrade paths and timing (owner: Sara).

Ravi (Infra): I'll include graphs in INF ticket and correlate with oakgrove's request patterns. Suspect 1 hour of retention for allowlist won't be sufficient if oakgrove repeats every night — may need proactive reservation detection.

Devon (Support): Thanks everyone. Marking this thread as "triaged — mitigation applied". Will close after follow-ups and INF-2026-211 updates. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread format: single continuous string in 'messages'. No title field per agents.md rules.
